Package midtermlabproject2

Class LinkedStack<T>

java.lang.Object
midtermlabproject2.LinkedStack<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of elements held in the stack
All Implemented Interfaces:
Stack<T>
public class LinkedStack<T> extends Object implements Stack<T>
Linked-list implementation of Stack (Module 3).

Elements are kept in a chain of Nodes with top pointing at the most recently pushed one. The element count is kept in sync on every push, pop and clear, so size() runs in constant time. No java.util stack classes are used.

    • buildBottomToTop

      private void buildBottomToTop(Node<T> node, StringBuilder sb, String separator, Function<T,String> formatter)
      Recursively appends elements bottom to top. The recursion reaches the bottom node first, so elements are appended in bottom-to-top order.
      Parameters:
      node - the node to process (the recursion ends at null)
      sb - the buffer being built
      separator - the text placed between elements
      formatter - converts an element to text
